//: Phase-2A build config — compiles the two repo-root dashboard-helper scripts that the COMPILED dist dashboards (node runtime/dist/bin/odg-health.js / odg-status.js) load at runtime, into runtime/dist/scripts/ as plain CommonJS. These scripts live at repo-root scripts/ (OUTSIDE tsconfig.runtime-dist.json's rootDir=runtime) so that config cannot emit them; under zero-JS there is no scripts/*.js, so the dist bins' require() previously failed and the §F Compass + CM-4 classified lines were honestly UNAVAILABLE. Emitting them into runtime/dist/scripts keeps dist self-contained (both scripts import ONLY Node builtins — no relative requires for build-dist-closure to chase, and the ORPHAN/STALE guard scans dist/core only). Mirrors the runtime-dist compilerOptions. Wired into scripts/build-runtime-guard.ts (fullBuild tsc pass + fingerprint inputs) so edits auto-invalidate the build cache.
